title: Mount errors: late, face to the gun, canting
summary: Mount faults that cause misses: a late or early mount, the face going to the gun and a canted gun, plus the gun position rules in Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting.

body.html: Many misses start before the swing, in the gun mount: the movement that brings the gun to cheek and shoulder. The coach's words for it are short and about the body: head, cheek, shoulder, hands.

Late mount: the gun reaches the shoulder after the moment the shot should have been fired, so the shooter rushes or fires before the cheek is down. The opposite fault is a mount finished too early, after which the gun waits, still and heavy. Cure: 'move, mount, shoot', where the muzzles start with the target and the mount is completed as the shot comes.

Face to the gun: instead of bringing the stock up to the face, the shooter drops the head to meet it. The eye ends up in a different place each time, and recoil hits the cheek. Coaches say: 'bring the gun to your face, not your face to the gun'. A stock landing on the arm instead of the shoulder pocket hurts too.
Canting: the gun is tilted sideways at the shot, and the shot drifts off the line. It often comes with a dropped shoulder. Cure: 'keep the gun level', 'turn from the hips'.

In FITASC Parcours de Chasse – Sporting™ competitions the gun may not be mounted before the target appears, so 'pre-mount this one' is a training drill only. Mounting early in a Sporting™ competition brings a warning and a yellow card. In Compak® Sporting the gun may already be at the shoulder at the call.
How a good mount works, step by step, is in Gun mount: the gun comes to your face.

notes.html: Translate the drill as a drill and add nothing of your own.

phrases.speaker: coach
phrases.en: Bring the gun to your face, not your face to the gun.
phrases.meaning: Lift the stock to the cheek; do not lower the head to the stock.

phrases.speaker: coach
phrases.en: Move, mount, shoot, all in one.
phrases.meaning: Start moving with the target, finish the mount as you fire, in one flowing action.

phrases.speaker: coach
phrases.en: You canted the gun, keep it level.
phrases.meaning: The gun was tilted sideways at the shot.

phrases.speaker: coach
phrases.meaning: The gun should come up already on the target's path.

phrases.speaker: coach
phrases.en: Pre-mount this one, just for practice.
phrases.meaning: Training drill with the gun already at the shoulder; not allowed in a Sporting™ competition.

key_points.html: Late mount: a rushed shot; cure: move, mount, shoot.
Face to the gun: the eye moves and recoil hurts; bring the gun to the face.
Canting: the shot drifts off the line; keep the gun level, turn from the hips.
Sporting™: pre-mount only as a training drill (in competition, mount after the target appears); in Compak® Sporting the gun may be mounted at the call.
